import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[9]
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[0]+params[1]*x+params[2]*v+params[3]*np.sin(v)+params[4]*v**2
            +params[5]*S+(params[6]+params[7]*x+params[8]*v)*C)
